evidence.role: Defines all factory-level configuration as constant or immutable and inherits no owner, admin, pausable, or upgradeable base contract.
Initializes all factory configuration and the shared Raffle implementation as immutables once in the constructor with no setter or upgrade functions.
Deploys each raffle as a fixed-target EIP-1167 minimal proxy clone of raffleImplementation and initializes it atomically once.
Locks the shared Raffle implementation at deployment (initialized = true) and fixes factory, quoteToken, and VRF wrapper as immutables.
Enforces one-time factory-only initialization of per-raffle configuration; no other function writes to these configuration variables.
Defines all protocol fee, entry price, batch size, timeout, and VRF parameters as compile-time constants.

structured_output.reasoning: Implemented (and not partial or contradicted) because every protocol parameter in RaffleConstants and RaffleFactory is constant or immutable, every clone is a fixed-target EIP-1167 proxy deployed via Clones.clone(raffleImplementation) with no upgrade mechanism, per-clone configuration in Raffle is written exclusively during one-time factory-only initialize(), and an exhaustive audit of all inheritance bases, state writes, and msg.sender checks confirms the complete absence of any admin/owner role, post-initialization config setter, pause gate, or token/NFT/ETH rescue path.

searched.result: 0 hits for contract-level owner/admin roles; owner and operator appear only as ERC-721 ticket owner/operator parameters/locals in Raffle.sol:L359-L360, L416-L426
searched.where: onlyOwner, Ownable, AccessControl, ConfirmedOwner, admin, authority, governor, operator in packages/contracts/src/**/*.sol and inherited base contracts

searched.result: 0 hits in executable code; mentioned only negatively in NatSpec comments (Raffle.sol:L25, L411; RaffleFactory.sol:L19; IRaffleFactory.sol:L7)
searched.where: pause, unpause, Pausable, rescue, sweep, recover, emergency, withdraw in packages/contracts/src/**/*.sol

searched.result: 0 hits in executable code of src/; delegatecall exists only inside the immutable 45-byte EIP-1167 clone bytecode in Clones.sol:L56
searched.where: delegatecall, selfdestruct, upgrade, UUPS, ERC1967, setImplementation in packages/contracts/src/**/*.sol and Clones.sol

searched.result: All 29 sites inspected; none grants administrative, configuration, pause, rescue, or upgrade privileges
searched.where: msg.sender and _msgSender() across RaffleFactory.sol, Raffle.sol, VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol, and ERC721.sol

searched.result: All storage writes inspected; configuration fields are written only in constructor and one-time initialize()
searched.where: All state variable declarations and assignments in RaffleFactory.sol and Raffle.sol
